propositions: A paired corpus run must measure structured-output validity, decision-level verdict agreement, recall, false-accept rate, and runtime error rate across both Bedrock and direct-Anthropic providers for the standard and frontier model classes before Bedrock can be claimed a first-class provider in S8.

Payload parity and tool parity must be proven by captured outbound requests at the provider boundary, showing the same system prompt, messages, tools, and inference parameters reach both providers modulo documented envelope differences.
Provider routing must be verified clean: a Bedrock-configured run must make zero calls to non-Bedrock providers, confirmed via per-call model tallying from REBAR_USAGE_LOG.

The corpus must pool 30 gold-labeled cases from 15 specs (15 block-class, 15 advisory-class) across non-agentic eval arms, excluding completion-verifier, ticket-quality, and spec-alignment, to meet the MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor.

Both Bedrock inference-profile IDs (us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8) must be confirmed invokable in account 896586841071 / us-east-1 via a pre-corpus step-1 probe with bare and temperature=0 requests.

The recorded ParityReport artifact must carry either a measured block with passed, gating_failures, metrics, and per-arm model IDs for each invokable slot, or an unmeasured block with exact refusal strings for slots that cannot be invoked.
